snippet.title: Locked in my Darkness 2: The Room | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist Locked in my Darkness 2: The Room now on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3330930/Locked_in_my_Darkness_2_The_Room/ 

Locked in my Darkness 2: The Room is a psychological horror game set from the perspective of a Japanese high school student in a New York apartment complex.
